summary: Publish the typed agent-related-runs client contract

replay.detail: SDK and JSON Schema changes only; no claims or replay behavior.

schema.detail: Adds AgentRelatedRuns, AgentRelatedRun and RelatedRunWait wire models and registers the projection read.

compatibility.detail: Generated Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients expose the additive sidebar projection. Route HTTP 404 is typed unsupported-capability, never an empty list. Roll out the daemon before callers; clients show unsupported visibly.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the new SDK methods and models without changing stored state.
